image_prompt.text: Scripted disaster volumes that periodically engulf the arena — floods, tornadoes, meteor strikes, quakes — damaging anything caught inside
Raised rooftops, ledges and rock shelves around the arena to climb to when the ground floods, burns or collapses
Multi-part welded buildings and player-raised structures the disaster scripts can realistically bring down
Classic flat build plots ringing the lobby plus an open freestyle expansion zone, all left clear for grid-based construction
A central lobby every player returns to between disaster rounds, with the plots, expansion zone and arena leading off it
Realistic roads chaining the central lobby out to the build plots, the freestyle expansion zone and the disaster arena
Large-scale landmarks — oversized realistic structures visible from across the map

layout_placement.text: Grid-based construction snapping across the build plots and the freestyle expansion zone

notes: Mixed: Survival dominant — the disaster arena and surviving the round are what the map is about — with Simulation second for the build-plot side. It was close; Simulation contributes options only and the shape stays Survival's.
Preset caveat from the file: Disaster Survival deliberately has no escape gate — the win is outlasting the timer — so gate-escape is absent on purpose.
Preset kept whole on its own shape. Added buildzone-plot from Survival, and social-hub and path-circulation from Simulation, for the lobby, plots, expansion zone and roads the prompt named.
'Expose attributes that help adjust the size and layout of the major zones' is a tunability/scripting request with no geometry, so it cannot be carried in the handoff.
'Super massive' is a scale statement, not a count; no numbers were stated, so no pick carries a count.
No Universal Option fired — the prompt asks for no water, terrain landform, settlement density, islands, NPCs or interiors.

would have asked: Sounds like a disaster survival round map — one bounded arena hit by scripted disasters, high ground to climb to, and buildings that collapse — with the central lobby, classic build plots, a freestyle expansion zone, and roads linking them all. Want that, or would you rather build it up yourself?

would have asked: whether the disaster arena is separate ground from the build plots or the same bounded space getting wrecked. Built as one continuous bounded map, which keeps it on the proven single-pass route; separate maps per zone isn't ready yet.
would have asked: whether any of the buildings or the lobby are actually enterable. Assumed facades, so no interior pass — say the word and I'll add it, though it's a slower build.
would have asked: Anything else you want in the space?
